title: I'm testing out a collaborative AI Dungeon Game
author: Lemon30
selftext:
Hi,

The idea of using AI for the games narrative has always fascinated me.

Thus, I loved AI dungeon when it first came out. So, I wanted to take it up one step further. I made a similar simple text-based RPG demo where 

- The story is generated by AI based on your interactions
- But, you can see and choose other players' responses as well as enter your own

Below you can find a quick gameplay video.
### [GAMEPLAY VIDEO](https://youtu.be/qeSaDVFYfDg)

Every step of the story you can do one of the following

- Pick 1 of the 3 [AI suggested options](https://i.imgur.com/V3nMzrM.png)
- Pick [an option given by another player previously](https://i.imgur.com/V3nMzrM.png)
- Enter [your unique response](https://imgur.com/ziaeXiO) which becomes available to all players afterwards.

Please try out the demo and let me know what you think!

### [TRY THE DEMO](https://bdr-card-r26g8s.flutterflow.app/)

I'm planning to add more collaborative options in the future but I wanted to share this demo as early as possible to gather some feedback.

Thanks!

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body:
Played the demo! Found it very interesting, even though I’m already tired of AI Dungeon like games (including AID) as I’m waiting for something with more gameplay mechanics, such as stats, items skills etc..

I actually enjoyed this concept of showing the paths that people took and how many people took each path. I hope lots of people here play it, so we can explore more this very innovative concept.

So yeah, people of this community, I’m waiting for you guys to play the game too so we can see what crazy path each one is taking and where it leads.
